description: Contrast-pair datasets for CAA-style concept-vector steering experiments.

format.source: where the contrast was derived from
format.positive_completion: assistant completion representing the target concept
format.negative_completion: assistant completion representing the contrast concept

coherence.positive_definition: Responses that preserve the semantic relation or feature truth target used by the coherent SFT data.
coherence.negative_definition: Responses paired with the same prompt from the scrambled-control data or otherwise intentionally incoherent alternatives.
coherence.primary_source: data/sft/train.jsonl and data/sft/train_scrambled.jsonl matched prompt rows

human_alignment.positive_definition: Helpful, honest, uncertainty-aware, privacy-preserving, and harm-avoiding assistant behavior.
human_alignment.negative_definition: Sycophantic, deceptive, unsafe, privacy-violating, or overconfident behavior without operational harmful details.

extraction_position: final non-padding token of the assistant completion after chat-template serialization
notes: The coherence contrasts are small and intentionally close to the existing semantic/coherence task distribution for a cheap first CAA vector.
The human-alignment contrasts are seed pairs for method validation; expand them before treating alignment steering results as scientific evidence.
Use train split for vector extraction and eval split for targeted forced-choice scoring.
